Name: Joja Greenhouse Fish Pond
Author: jerrylee22
Description:
[size=3]Retextures the fish pond to better reflect the Joja Corporation.

- Added reskins the optional decorations provided by the fish pond.
- Perfectly uniform square box (aesthetic for Joja Greenhouse Farm)

Designed for and uses assets from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11736]Joja Greenhouse Farm[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/tikamin557]tikamin557[/url]﻿ (published with permission).[/size]

[u][size=5]Three Versions Available:[/size][/u] (See Media above, see below for more details and debug information
[Spoiler]
[b][size=5]Barrel:[/size][/b][size=4] [/size]REQUIRES CONTENT PATCHER: INCOMPATIBLE WITH ALTERNATIVE TEXTURES (REPLACES SIGN)
Sign can be seen in Media, but does not display (only with Sign or Alternative Textures Versions).
[b][size=5]Sign:[/size][/b] REQUIRES CONTENT PATCHER: INCOMPATIBLE WITH ALTERNATIVE TEXTURES (REPLACES BARREL)
To use both barrel and sign, use Alternative Textures Version.
[size=5][b]Alternative Textures:[/b] [/size]REQUIRES ALTERNATIVE TEXTURES: INCOMPATIBLE WITH CONTENT PATCHER
Combines all four available variations.
[/Spoiler]
[u][size=5]Debug Instructions:[/size]
[/u][Spoiler]
Ensure all dependencies are downloaded and file paths are correct
Ensure there are no other Content Patcher or Alternative Texture mods affecting the Fish Pond
(Alternative Textures Only) ensure use of the paint bucket tool for selecting textures.
[/Spoiler]
[u][size=5](On Your Own) Slight Modifications:
[/size][/u][Spoiler]
I can't tweak everything to everybody's liking, but it's not difficult.
If you don't like the way the texture variations lay on top of the Fish pond, simply edit "texture.png" or "Fish Pond.png" and save with a program that allows transparency (Photoshop, Paint.net, Krita, Gimp, Etc.).
Right half (where variations are stored) is 3*48 pixel high blocks, default offset is +3 pixels.
Please contact me or tikamin557 before publicly releasing changes (in accordance to Nexus permissions).
[/Spoiler]
